name: Somraji Taila (Oil)

sections.introduction: Somraji Taila (Oil) is an herbal Ayurvedic oil very useful in treatment of various skin conditions like eczema, gout, pruritus etc. It is applied externally. Its main ingredient is mustard oil base.
sections.ingredients_and_method_of_preparation:
Form paste using fine powders of 24 g of each of:- 

 Somaraji ( Psoralea corylifolia ) 
 Haridra (Turmeric rhizome) ( Curcuma longa ) 
 Daruharidra – Berberis aristata – stem 
 Sarshapa (Mustard seed) ( Brassica juncea ) 
 Kushta ( Saussurea lappa ) 
 Karanja (Indian Beech) ( Pongamia pinnata ) – bark / seed 
 Edagajabeeja ( Cassia tora ) 
 Aragvadha ( Cassia fistula ) 
 Sarshapa Taila (Mustard Oil) – 768 ml 
 Water – 3.072 liters 

 Heat all ingredients till only its oil remains behind and then filter it. Then store it in cool and dry place, keeping away from direct sunlight. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Somraji Taila is very useful Ayurvedic oil for various skin conditions. It is effective in skin problems like in Psoriasis, improves the immunity and promotes the purification of blood, thereby providing relief from itching, reduces inflammation and redness, giving soothing effect to patient. It is also effective to use in eczema and dermatitis, helps to get rid of painful red rashes and itching, manages profuse discharge. It brings great relief from other allergic skin conditions characterized by itching. It is also useful in scabies too, liberates a person from the discomfort of itching. It is helpful Ayurvedic remedy in case of ringworm and various other skin problems. It is also helpful in managing the condition of leucoderma. Can be used in pityriasis condition too, lessen the rashes. Even helpful in leprosy. It is even efficient to use for patients with STDs (Sexually Transmitted Diseases).
sections.therapeutic_uses:
Useful Ayurvedic remedy for treating eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis, allergic skin conditions with itching. 
 Also beneficial in Leprosy, vitiligo and ringworm infections.
sections.how_to_use:
Use by applying it over the affected area. 
 Externally can be applied for long period of time.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
No side effects has been reported till now with use of this medicine. 
 Keep it away from reach of children. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Somraji Taila (Oil) 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Nadivrana Rogadhikara 39 
 Introduction 
 Somraji Taila (Oil) is an herbal Ayurvedic oil very useful in treatment of various skin conditions like eczema, gout, pruritus etc. It is applied externally. Its main ingredient is mustard oil base. 
 Ingredients and Method of Preparation 
 Form paste using fine powders of 24 g of each of:- 
 
 Somaraji ( Psoralea corylifolia ) 
 Haridra (Turmeric rhizome) ( Curcuma longa ) 
 Daruharidra – Berberis aristata – stem 
 Sarshapa (Mustard seed) ( Brassica juncea ) 
 Kushta ( Saussurea lappa ) 
 Karanja (Indian Beech) ( Pongamia pinnata ) – bark / seed 
 Edagajabeeja ( Cassia tora ) 
 Aragvadha ( Cassia fistula ) 
 Sarshapa Taila (Mustard Oil) – 768 ml 
 Water – 3.072 liters 
 
 Heat all ingredients till only its oil remains behind and then filter it. Then store it in cool and dry place, keeping away from direct sunlight. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Somraji Taila is very useful Ayurvedic oil for various skin conditions. It is effective in skin problems like in Psoriasis, improves the immunity and promotes the purification of blood, thereby providing relief from itching, reduces inflammation and redness, giving soothing effect to patient. It is also effective to use in eczema and dermatitis, helps to get rid of painful red rashes and itching, manages profuse discharge. It brings great relief from other allergic skin conditions characterized by itching. It is also useful in scabies too, liberates a person from the discomfort of itching. It is helpful Ayurvedic remedy in case of ringworm and various other skin problems. It is also helpful in managing the condition of leucoderma. Can be used in pityriasis condition too, lessen the rashes. Even helpful in leprosy. It is even efficient to use for patients with STDs (Sexually Transmitted Diseases). 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Useful Ayurvedic remedy for treating eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis, allergic skin conditions with itching. 
 Also beneficial in Leprosy, vitiligo and ringworm infections. 
 
 How to Use? 
 Use by applying it over the affected area. 
 Externally can be applied for long period of time. 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 No side effects has been reported till now with use of this medicine. 
 Keep it away from reach of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
